learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to discover the importance of the phenomenon of culture within the framework of communication, art, the evolution of ideas, and political and social events.
Students will be able to explain the general outlines of how the formation, functioning, evolution, and change of culture and cultural activities have taken place from ancient times to the present.
Students will be able to describe the stages of scientific and intellectual evolution in human history.
Students will be able to interpret how scientists, thinkers, and artists, as well as movements, have shaped human culture.
Students will be able to define the functions and characteristics of artistic activities within their historical evolutionary processes.

syllabus_topics: General evaluations on the concept of culture, definitions of culture
Cultural diffusion, perspectives of societies and history
Emergence of Turkish culture; history and geography
Fundamental institutions of the Turkish socio-cultural structure
The concept of 'civilization' and its entry into Turkish society
History and ideology / Perspectives on Turkish history
The place of the Turkish language in Turkish cultural history
Turkish political institution, the place of Turkish language in the Turkish state understanding
Research techniques and steps, preparing questionnaires
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course plan. These dates are determined by the University Senate and announced in the academic calendar.
